issues.what: The route to Tbilisi is told three ways: Poland camp, bus to Istanbul and a flight (ch1), then a lorry through Romania and Turkey (ch2), then Lviv/Rivne (ch3).
issues.quote: Then bus to Istanbul. Then plane here. Doctor in Istanbul said Tbilisi.

issues.what: The Black Sea / two-phage realisation happens in ch3, then ch4-5 present it again as a new discovery (planned moment used up early).
issues.quote: If he picked up a Black Sea strain first, then a river strain here, we may need two phages.

issues.what: The 1983 label is told two ways: 'For M. G. lung' naming her grandfather (ch4) against 'Batumi port 14.03.1983' (ch6); the dead patient is a Rustavi boy, not M. G.
issues.quote: For M. G. lung. Do not use without washing twice.

issues.what: Nana 'worked in the media kitchen' and 'never touched the collection', but ch1-2 and ch5 say she isolated 400 strains and collected at Batumi port.
issues.quote: She worked in the media kitchen. She never touched the collection.

issues.what: The vial moves: ch4-5 put it in the lab fridge, then it cracks in the back-room freezer at the end of ch5 and in ch6.
issues.quote: from the back room came a sharp crack

issues.what: Last year's lost patient becomes 'a girl with a burned leg' (ch1-2: a girl from Batumi); the wine flask moves to her office and is tied to her death, not the family custom.
issues.quote: flask of wine in her office that she never opened after last year's patient

issues.what: Dates are wrong: the Batumi trip was a few days earlier in winter, not summer; 1983 to 2033 is fifty years, not forty; the vial is dated March, not summer.
issues.quote: Cold for summer.

issues.what: The pool is placed in Gori here and in Kobuleti in ch5.
issues.quote: a swimming pool in Gori

issues.what: Two planned moments missing: the boy never wakes asking for his father in Ukrainian, and Eteri never drinks the wine.
issues.quote: His fever held at 37.4. The drain came out.

issues.what: Revaz invites them 'tonight' but the meeting happens the evening after the treatment the next day.
issues.quote: Bring your torchbearer tonight. Eight o'clock.

issues.what: The drawing is introduced again as if new, and the route list moves from a fuel receipt (ch2) to the bottom of the drawing.
issues.quote: Along the bottom, in a careful adult hand, a list ran in Ukrainian.

issues.what: Three chapters share the title 'The 1983 Vial'; ch1 'The Sewers Below' has no sewers; ch2 'The Unlabelled Vial' is labelled.
issues.quote: The 1983 Vial

issues.what: Repeated images: 'wet cement' sky, 'colour of weak tea', 'reagents smelled faintly of sea', 'tapped his cane once against the floor'.
issues.quote: the color of wet cement

fix: Ch1: switch the route to the lorry route (Odesa, Isaccea, Turkey, Sarpi). Ch3: drop the early Black Sea/two-phage idea, set the meeting for 'tomorrow night', stop reintroducing the drawing. Ch4: rewrite the label and Nana lines, fix the lost patient and wine, change the Gori pool to Kobuleti, put the vial in the lab freezer. Ch5: fix the season and the fifty years, have the vial crack in the lab freezer. Ch6: match the vial and label, and add the Ukrainian wake-up and the wine. Retitle all six chapters.
praise: The lab work is exact and tactile, and Bohdan's broken Russian with Eteri is the story's warm heart.

issues.what: Planned-moment brief text is pasted straight into the prose three times.
issues.quote: In the Cathedral, Jolene's light finds Darlene's face, and neither of them knows what to say

issues.what: Darlene climbs out first and leaves both teens below, after saying 'I come last'; the surface team never pulls anyone up the rope.
issues.quote: The ramp pinched at the top. Darlene squeezed through a tight mud crawl

issues.what: A recap paragraph re-describes the coveralls/rain scene from ch1 with wrong details (Hollis's truck door, hot hood).
issues.quote: Darlene thought of the fire hall lot that afternoon

issues.what: The 'older way round' is the 2011 high crawl in ch1 and a different slot marked '?' 'fifteen years ago' in ch2 (2009 in ch3).
issues.quote: marked with a question mark fifteen years ago, the older way round

issues.what: Tying a casualty's wrist to your own belt on a traverse above a drop is unsafe caving practice.
issues.quote: Darlene tied Priya's wrist to her own belt with a short sling

issues.what: Priya calls her own ankle 'her ankle'; knee injury swapped for the hip she slammed; 'Mrs. Elkins's classroom' when it is Darlene's own.
issues.quote: Her ankle is not broken, I think.

issues.what: The sneaker print is explained as Cody's but he only used the ramp, and in ch3 it was dated 'before the rain' though he came during it.
issues.quote: Cody's sneaker prints went up and down it a dozen times.

issues.what: Real brands: Subaru (ch1), Foodland (ch4).
issues.quote: bagged groceries at Foodland

issues.what: A 16-year-old failing a middle-school teacher's class is unexplained; ch4 says she failed a 'test', ch1-2 say a missed project and labs.
issues.quote: You failed the test. Different thing.

issues.what: Generic or wrong titles: ch2 'The Squeeze' happens in ch1.
issues.quote: The Squeeze

fix: Ch4: remove the pasted brief lines and the recap; the girls go up first on the rope pulled by the surface team and Darlene comes out last; fix the sneaker-print explanation, 'failed the test' and Foodland. Ch1: remove Subaru, explain why Jolene is 16 in middle school, and make A14 the high crawl. Ch2: set the question-mark slot to 2009, use chest-harness slings on the traverse, and fix 'her ankle', knee/hip and the classroom. Ch3: fix the print timing. Retitle ch2-4.
praise: The caving is physical and specific (the Squeeze, the traverse, the counting), and Jolene's anger at being failed gives the rescue its sting.
